title: viem is not declared in package.json: the mandatory gather prerequisite cannot run from a clean checkout
location: gather-migration-inputs.js:130-136; package.json dependencies (cors, express only; devDependencies: @wagmi/cli)
description: gather-migration-inputs.js requires viem and exits with 'viem not installed. Run `npm install` in the project root first.' — but viem is absent from both dependencies and devDependencies, so npm install does not provide it and the suggested remedy fails. The operator must know to npm install viem manually. Since leg1 hard-depends on the gather output, this is a setup blocker on any fresh machine — exactly the environment a Ledger-signing mainnet operation is likely to run from.
impact: Runbook friction/blocker only; no on-chain effect.
